audience: teams that send documents for e-signature with SignWell and track them until they are signed

useCases.title: Check whether a document is a draft, sent or completed
useCases.text: Read one document by its id to see its status and its recipients.

useCases.title: Get a link to the signed PDF of a finished document
useCases.text: Get a download link for the completed, signed PDF of one document. The link comes from SignWell.

useCases.title: Track a bulk send
useCases.text: List the bulk sends, read one with its status, then list the documents it created.

useCases.title: Create a draft from a template
useCases.text: Check the placeholder ids of a template. Create a draft document from it. Nothing is emailed until you send it.

useCases.title: Send a draft for signature
useCases.text: Send a draft document for signature. SignWell emails every recipient at once, and this cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Remind recipients who have not signed
useCases.text: Send a signing reminder to recipients who have not signed yet. Omit the recipients to remind everyone who is pending.
